violations.name: MissingBucketPolicyRule
violations.message: S3 bucket should likely have a bucket policy

violations.name: S3BucketAccessLoggingRule
violations.message: S3 Bucket should have access logging configured

violations.name: S3BucketEncryptionSetRule
violations.message: S3 Bucket should have encryption option set

violations.name: S3BucketPublicReadWriteAclRule
violations.message: S3 Bucket should not have a public read-write acl

violations.name: SecurityGroupIngressCidrNon32Rule
violations.message: Security Groups found with ingress cidr that is not /32

violations.name: SecurityGroupIngressOpenToWorldRule
violations.message: Security Groups found with cidr open to world on ingress.  This should never be true on instance.  Permissible on ELB

violations.name: SecurityGroupMissingEgressRule
violations.message: Missing egress rule means all traffic is allowed outbound.  Make this explicit if it is desired configuration

violations.name: SecurityGroupRuleDescriptionRule
violations.message: Security group rules without a description obscure their purpose and may lead to bad practices in ensuring they only allow traffic from the ports and sources/destinations required.

violations.name: SqsQueueKmsMasterKeyIdRule
violations.message: SQS Queue should specify KmsMasterKeyId property

violations.name: UserHasInlinePolicyRule
violations.message: IAM user should not have any inline policies.  Should be centralized Policy object on group

violations.name: UserMissingGroupRule
violations.message: User is not assigned to a group
